name: DatePickerPopover
description: Date field with a Calendar panel, ISO strings, min/max and keyboard selection.
designIntent: The native date input opens browser chrome that differs per browser. DatePickerPopover pairs a themed trigger with Calendar in a Popover, so the visible month, week start and disabled days are yours, while the value remains a plain ISO string.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fired with the ISO key when a day is chosen.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the trigger label and the grid.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger text before a date is chosen.

props.name: name
props.description: Renders a hidden input so the value posts with a native form.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the panel; flips when it cannot fit.

props.name: id
props.description: Id for the trigger button, for label association.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the trigger.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Themed field with a calendar panel.

examples.title: In a form
examples.description: Hidden input carries the ISO value.

antiPatterns.title: Don't parse the label
antiPatterns.explanation: The visible text is localized. Read the ISO value, never the trigger text.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest inside another dialog
antiPatterns.explanation: Popover is non-modal; nesting it in a Dialog works, but nesting a Dialog inside it does not. Use a Drawer for long forms.

accessibility.implementation: The trigger is a button with aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.
accessibility.userRequirements: Give it a label when the field has no visible one.

accessibility.implementation: Enter/Space opens; arrows navigate; Enter selects and returns focus to the trigger; Escape closes.
accessibility.userRequirements: Do not trap focus: the panel is non-modal.

guidelines: Show a localized date once chosen

compositionRules.relationship: The panel is a Calendar; use it directly for an inline grid
Wrap with FormField for label, hint and error wiring
